register_gap: Onboarding pages hold two registers — one 13pt tracked-caps eyebrow and one ~44pt serif act with a single italic punch word — and compose 55-75% of the page as cream; the app opens with three stacked caps bands in its first ~180pt (MONDAY JULY 27, DAY 12 · WEEK 2 OF 20, FROM JENI), shrinks the serif to 34-40pt, and surrounds it with six to eight utility voices: 6+ chevrons on p2_becoming, 7 outlined chips on p4_home_evening_list, a leading radio circle, a truncated italic teaser ("this is day 12, n..."), a roman folio. Onboarding sets data as typography — a ~64pt serif "500" with italic "calories", label-left/number-right hairline ledgers — while the app sets data as dashboard furniture: folio_v6 prints its MORNING/AFTERNOON/EVENING caps twice and states its one insight in two different registers on the same page. And the app carries zero photography — charts are its only imagery — where onboarding proved the brand by handing a full-bleed plate photograph 48% of the screen.
onboarding_dna: One tracked-caps eyebrow (~13pt, ~+0.2em, warm grey-cocoa) is the ONLY furniture above the headline; no second caps band exists anywhere in 22 beats.
Display serif at ~42-46pt with exactly one italic punch word, arriving after 120-180pt of composed cream on statement beats; the headline IS the page.
55-75% of statement/receipt pages left empty; even five-option list beats keep the bottom ~40% cream, with option rows at ~90-100pt pitch.
Data as typography: '500' at ~64pt serif + italic serif unit, '41g protein' with rose italic g; ingredient ledger label-left/number-right over one 0.5pt hairline; zero bars, badges, or cards.
One interactive object per page (the single cocoa pill, ~64pt tall) or none at all ('tap to continue' as ghost text); zero chevrons and zero disclosure arrows across the entire flow.
Hairlines (~0.5pt, low-contrast) appear only as ledger/receipt rules, never as section chrome; receipts set the value right-aligned with a serif-italic punch ('food is fuel').
Photography is permitted to be enormous: the snap demo gives a full-bleed plate the top ~48% of the screen with the type sheet floating beneath it.
Selection grammar is quiet: thin-stroked outline chips or plain circles with generous air; selected state is ink, never fill-color blocks.

screen_directions.direction: Collapse the header to ONE eyebrow (MONDAY, JULY 27); the DAY 12 · WEEK 2 OF 20 caps band and its chevron die (fold into the letter dateline or the menu), the truncated FROM JENI teaser dies (full serif sentence or nothing). THE ONE THING grows from ~40pt to 52pt and takes the center third with 200pt of cream above it, em-rule kept. All numbers compress to ONE bottom receipt line in onboarding ledger grammar — serif numerals, sans labels: 860 of ~1,473 · room for ~600 · 62g · 6,420 steps — no chevrons, no steps sub-line, no connect/x banner. The screen becomes a single-act ceremony page: eyebrow, act, receipt, cream.

The landing TOC of caps+serif+chevron rows dies entirely — becoming opens INTO the first spread: jeni's read as a 44pt cover line, and the swipe begins immediately. Each signal becomes a full-page spread: one eyebrow, one 40pt serif claim, one chart printed in flat ink (kill folio_v6's grey gradient bars, rounded caps, and its duplicated MORNING/AFTERNOON/EVENING label row; kill the second restating paragraph — the italic serif pull-quote carries it alone). Her own plate photographs enter as the art program — one full-bleed spread per week. The floating back-disc dies; the fore-edge ticks replace 'i · of xii'. Becoming becomes the feature well she flips, visibly a different room from Home's single ceremony page.

This is the register anchor — extend it, don't dilute it. Raise the letter from ~34pt to 38-40pt; replace the JENI———monday rule with a single dateline eyebrow (FROM JENI · MONDAY, 13pt tracked); keep the jeni ♥ sign-off right-aligned. Demote the 64pt reply pill to onboarding's ghost grammar — 'reply' as quiet text with 'keep it ♥' beneath — so the page stays stationery, not dialog chrome. The letter becomes a tipped-in note, the page every other screen answers to.

Bubbles lose their tails and card-white fills: jeni's messages become unbordered notes on cream separated by 0.5pt hairlines under the existing italic 'today' dateline; the user's stay rose but tailless at 24pt radius. The bordered trend module card and its 'open the full trend >' chevron row die — a bare chart with an italic serif caption instead. The masthead pair (jeni / YOUR COACH · MONDAY) stays. The thread stops reading as iMessage-on-cream and becomes kept correspondence on one continuous page.

Hold every shipped result to the beat the founder already signed (onboarding snap demo): the photograph owns the top half full-bleed; below it ONE serif number at ~64pt with italic unit (500 calories ±75), the ingredient ledger with right-aligned numbers over one hairline, and the italic verdict sentence (it fits. no drama either way.). Any badge, second container, or pager-dot chrome on the result dies. The snap result becomes a cover shot with cover lines — the most editorial data page in the app.

checklist_signature.concept_name: THE KEPT LINE — signing, not checking
checklist_signature.at_rest: No circles, no boxes, no leading glyphs. Each intention is a flush-left JeniHeroSerif sentence at ~26pt set in cocoa at ~45% strength — an unsigned galley line — with a 0.5pt hairline at 12% cocoa sitting 10pt beneath it like the signature line on a letter. Row pitch ~88pt; page margins 24pt; nothing else on the row. Unkept reads as 'not yet inked', never as 'incomplete task'.
checklist_signature.completion: Press-and-hold (~450ms). During the hold the sentence takes ink — 45% to 100% cocoa — as the hairline redraws itself left-to-right in rose (~300ms ease-out); at the rule's end the jeni mark ✦ (12pt, rose) settles like a press seal, and one soft haptic swell crests exactly as the ✦ lands (crescendo curve, never a tick). The sentence's punch word flips to Fraunces italic as the ink takes. Kept lines remain on the page at full ink with their small rose ✦ terminals — the day accumulates signed lines.
checklist_signature.day_complete: When the last line takes ink, the page performs the colophon: every ✦ releases from its line and gathers beneath the final sentence into a single centered 18pt rose ✦; under it the date sets itself in 13pt tracked caps (MONDAY · 3 OF 3, KEPT); one long low haptic; the page holds ~900ms of stillness before anything returns. No scatter, no confetti — the seal and the silence ARE the reward.
checklist_signature.why_inevitable: The gesture is the one onboarding already taught at the her-file signature (hold-to-sign); the ✦ is already the brand's today glyph in the tab bar, so the reward mark is the identity mark; and it is built from the only three materials the app owns — serif line, hairline, ✦. Checking off becomes signing the day's page. Todoist cannot follow: it has no signature to press into the paper.

becoming_pagination.description: Position is felt as remaining paper under the right thumb, the way a magazine thins as you read: a vertical stack of short hairline ticks tucked into the bottom-right corner, one 0.5pt tick per page, 3pt apart. Pages already read: 16pt long at 12% cocoa. The open page: 24pt at full rose. Pages ahead: 16pt at 25% cocoa. The stack visibly thins as she moves deeper into the well — thickness, not arithmetic; no numerals, no words, no centered system-dot pager. A soft detent haptic per turn; on the final spread a single tick remains, then fades.

deletions: p5_functional_home: the second caps band 'DAY 12 · WEEK 2 OF 20 · FINDING STEADY >' — one eyebrow per page; the program line moves into the letter dateline or the menu.
p5_functional_home: the truncated 'FROM JENI back after 10 days. this is day 12, n...' teaser — a letter is never truncated; full sentence or nothing.
p5_functional_home: the cycle banner row — left rule + 'connect' pill + 'x' dismiss is productivity furniture; if the thought matters it arrives inside the letter.
p5_functional_home: the steps row's chevron and 'counted for you' sub-line — steps become part of the single bottom receipt line.
p4_home_evening_list: all seven outlined chips (proud/okay/tender + wait 60 seconds/tea first/plate it properly/an early night) — replaced by plain serif word-choices with air, no strokes.
p4_home_evening_list: the leading radio circle on 'snap a meal / still open' — THE KEPT LINE removes every circle from the app.
p2_becoming: the entire chevron column (6+ '>' glyphs) and the 'tap to open' instruction label — a magazine never instructs you to turn its pages.
folio_scrollpager + folio_v6: the 'i · of xii' roman folio, the floating white back-disc, and folio_v6's duplicated caps label row + second restating paragraph.
one_transformative_move: Adopt the onboarding page grammar app-wide — exactly one 13pt tracked eyebrow, one serif act at 44pt or larger, one quiet utility register, cream owning half of every page — and delete every third voice (chevrons, chips, radio circles, teasers, folios, back-discs); the moment a screen carries only two registers, it stops being an interface and becomes a page.
